1.

Our Lord, though afar, yet near, Though unseen, we worship Thee. Thy name above all names is Our refuge on the pilgrim’s way.

2.

Come, Lord, and fetch us home, O, leave us here no longer, Let the morning’s light break in, The trumpet proclaim Thee nigh!

3.

Above among the number of saints No fear, no wavering faith, Naught from the vale of tears Shall disturb our blissful rest.

4.

And should we yet remember it, The memory shall not distress our soul, But only increase our praise to our Friend, To Him who hath done all things well.

5.

Yet while we still walk here, All darkness in light is dissolved, If only we see the Unseen One, Who Himself is our life and our hope.
